scope: Actual frontend standard0..6/hexdump, dequeue, overflow/skip and atomic/critical code; ring wrap, saturation, in-progress entries, memobj failure, hexdump clamp/wrap, backend delivery and skip mutations
limitations: Backend callbacks remain fixtures; memory-object/pool bodies execute when actual_memobj is true. Failed-allocation scenarios use a depleted pool in that mode.

Canonical bool state, valid bounded packet streams and finite callback scripts; lengths1024..4088 are producer-only packing checks because the ten-bit header length wraps; malformed nonterminating streams and real concurrency remain gates.
Production logger initialization/registration, physical transport, original compiler/link identity and byte equality remain unresolved; memobj bodies are exercised only in actual_memobj mode.
